description.zh: 非官方豆包（Doubao）提供商插件：扫码登录豆包网页/桌面账号，向 CLIProxyAPI 暴露豆包对话模型。签名层可替换，默认直连。与字节跳动无关联。
description.en: Unofficial Doubao provider: sign in with a Doubao web/desktop account via QR, and expose Doubao chat models to CLIProxyAPI. The signing layer is pluggable; direct mode is the default. Not affiliated with ByteDance.
description.zh-Hant: 非官方豆包（Doubao）提供者外掛：掃碼登入豆包網頁/桌面帳號，向 CLIProxyAPI 暴露豆包對話模型。簽名層可替換，預設直連。與字節跳動無關聯。
